gloss: in a rush; all at once; suddenly

definitions.gloss: in a rush; all at once
definitions.explanation: A large amount or many people suddenly moving or appearing at once.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}がどっと{笑|わら}った。
{仕事|しごと}がどっと{増|ふ}えた。

examples.english: Fatigue suddenly hit me all at once.

notes:
USAGE:
どっと + verb

Emphasizes sudden, forceful, or overwhelming action:
・どっと{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる (to surge in)
・どっと{湧|わ}く (to well up suddenly)
・どっと{泣|な}く (to burst into tears)
・どっと{笑|わら}う (to burst out laughing)
・どっと{倒|たお}れる (to collapse)

NUANCE:
Conveys the image of something overwhelming in volume or intensity happening suddenly.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{一気|いっき}に - all at once (more controlled)
・{急|きゅう}に - suddenly
・ばっと - with a splash/burst
